notes:
- New first-person arms and hands on every gun ("FPS Arms" by HuskySkullz, CC BY 4.0, in the Credits):
  sleeves in your outfit's colour, hands in your skin tone. The right hand wraps the grip with a finger on
  the trigger (it pulls when you fire); the left holds the handguard, or cups your right hand on a
  handgun. They follow every reload (mags, pumps, bolts, break-opens).
- Drum Mags look like the real thing for each gun: a twin-drum C-Mag on the Vanguard and Tri-Burst,
  a single drum on the Rattler and Hornet, and a box mag on the Grinder and Buzzsaw.
- Iron sights: the Rattler's (and the Hornet's, Grinder's, DMR's and shotguns') sights no longer
  block your view when aiming; the Rattler's optics sit higher too.
- Round counter: rounds I to IX in Roman numerals, then 10, 11, 12..., in blood red with a ROUND
  caption, punching in white-hot at the start of each round.
- Twin Dragons (Twin Barrels Tier III) and Dragon's Breath (Boomstick Tier III) shoot a roaring
  jet of fire you can see.
- Camo challenges rebalanced around Dark Matter at 1500 headshots (plus gun level 50): Woodland 10,
  Desert 30, Urban 60, Arctic 100, Crimson 160, Tiger 240, Gold 350, Diamond 500, Plasma 750.
- Seal Launcher goes off the moment it hits something.
- Slide kicks are weaker (they were one-shotting zombies late on); the Boot upgrade adds up to 50%.
- The crash-through window vault no longer sinks zombies into the floor.
